title: UNSTEADY axisymmetric turbulent plume on T8's fine mesh -- the T8 successor named by the record as its sharpest next test
parent: T8 (NOT A RESULT, docs/campaigns/T-family/T8_VERDICT_2026-08-26.md); the discriminator named at docs/campaigns/T-family/T8_STEADINESS_MEASUREMENT_2026-08-26.md sections 6.2 and 7.4
capability_grid_cell: natural convection (free plume) x turbulent (URANS kEpsilon) x 2D axisymmetric wedge (docs/capability/heat-transfer_GRID.md)
capability_ceiling: CAN DO, CAVEATS -- ONE MESH. No Roache triple exists for this rung and none may be computed from it; no GCI, no Richardson extrapolate and no discretisation uncertainty is quoted on any row.

physics.alpha_nominal_role: sets the Gamma_0 = 1 pure-plume SOURCE condition and the closed form's virtual origin ONLY; it appears in no band and in no gate

roache_floors.source: scripts/roache_triple.py, imported by name (MESH_STANDARD.md section 10.5, chief ruling 01967a7b); the comparator defines none of them and REFUSES if these numbers differ from the import. They are EXERCISED in the comparator's selftest so the import is demonstrably live, and gci_equal is called on NO graded row of this one-mesh rung.

S1.quantity: sigma(w)/mean(w) of the axis-region probe at z = 3.0 m over the window [120, 240] s
S1.grading: SINGLE MESH -- band verdict only, no triple, no GCI
S1.band_ground: 2 percent of the mean is the registered threshold separating a settled URANS field from a persistent fluctuation. A puffing plume mode carries 10-30 percent centreline velocity fluctuation; numerical residue of a settled field is below 0.5 percent. 2 percent sits an order of magnitude below the phenomenon and four times above the residue.
S1.what_it_falsifies: PASS (<= 0.02) falsifies the GENUINELY-UNSTEADY hypothesis as the explanation of T8's failure AT THIS RESOLUTION AND IN THIS AXISYMMETRIC GEOMETRY; GATE FAIL (> 0.02), read together with S2 >= 0.5, falsifies the settling prediction of the under-resolution/closure hypothesis.

V1.quantity: n_w: OLS slope of ln(centreline time-mean w) on ln(z - z0), z/D in [10, 25], 31 stations
V1.grading: SINGLE MESH -- band verdict only, no triple, no GCI
V1.band_ground: +-0.05 absolute, the band T8 registered for the same quantity on the same geometry with the same closure and the same fit window (T8_PREREGISTRATION.md section 4). It is a MODELLING-tolerance band, not a numerical one, and it is NOT widened here: it separates a plume (-1/3) from a jet (-1) by 13.3 band widths and from a non-entraining column (0) by 6.67.

V2.quantity: n_T: OLS slope of ln(centreline time-mean T - TRef) on ln(z - z0), same window and stations
V2.grading: SINGLE MESH -- band verdict only, no triple, no GCI

V3.quantity: db/dz: OLS slope of the top-hat radius b = Q/sqrt(pi M) on z from the MEASURED cell volumes, same window and stations
V3.grading: SINGLE MESH -- band verdict only, no triple, no GCI
V3.band_ground: MTT gives b = (6 alpha / 5) z exactly, so db/dz = 1.2 alpha. The band is 1.2 x the published pure-plume entrainment range alpha in [0.11, 0.13]: [0.132, 0.156]. This is an EMPIRICAL band, not an exact reference, and it is the row on which the kEpsilon round-jet/plane-jet anomaly is expected to show (T8_PREREGISTRATION.md section 2, prediction P1). The registered point 0.144 is 1.2 x alpha_nominal.

C_CO.what: max Courant number over the REGISTERED WINDOW [120, 240] s <= 1.0; a fixed-step transient integrated above its registered Courant number is not the registered integration -> gate (1) NOT A RESULT on every row. The max over the WHOLE run (start-up included) is REPORTED and never gated: the start-up transient is discarded by construction.

C_STAT.what: STATIONARITY PRECONDITION. |OLS trend of the S1 probe series x window length| / |window mean| <= 0.05. A statistic taken on a series that is still moving is not a property of the run -- the failure T8_STEADINESS_MEASUREMENT_2026-08-26.md section 0 records twice. Exceeding it -> gate (1) NOT A RESULT on every row.

S2.what: PERSISTENCE, REPORTED AND NEVER GATED: sigma over the second half of the window divided by sigma over the first half. Registered reading, fixed before compute: >= 0.5 is a PERSISTENT fluctuation (consistent with genuine unsteadiness); < 0.5 is a DECAYING one (consistent with settling).

S3.what: the same fluctuation statistic on T at the same probe, REPORTED, never gated.

C_BOUND.what: epsilon/k bounding events per timestep, REPORTED AND DELIBERATELY NEVER GATED: T8 bounded epsilon on every level from Time = 24, and gating the very phenomenon this rung is diagnosing would make the rung NOT A RESULT for its own subject.

C_OP.what: operand identity (L-331): nu, beta, TRef, b0, w0, g'0 READ FROM THE CASE FILES; F0 recomputed from them must match CASE.txt to 1e-9; refuses otherwise.

C_GEOM.what: MEASURED geometry only. Cell centres and cell volumes are read from 0/Cx, 0/Cz, 0/V that OpenFOAM wrote (the launcher runs writeCellCentres and writeCellVolumes before the solver). The axis value is the parabolic-with-zero-axis-slope extrapolation (f1 r2^2 - f2 r1^2)/(r2^2 - r1^2) at the MEASURED radii; the ONLY geometric fact asserted anywhere is the STRUCTURAL r2 > r1 > 0. The measured r2/r1 and the measured wedge-to-annulus SCALE are PRINTED and gated on nothing. T8 GROUND 2 (T8_VERDICT_2026-08-26.md section 4) is the whole reason.

C_Z0.what: the virtual origin z0 is the x-intercept of the OLS line b(z) = s(z - z0) over the 31 stations -- T8's registered route (T8_PREREGISTRATION.md section 12 S4). The exponents refitted at z0 = 0, and the closed-form z0 = -b0/(6 alpha_nominal/5) = -0.694444 m, are both REPORTED. NOTE, recorded before compute: T8 section 12 S2's PROSE claim that a Gamma_0 = 1 source puts the virtual origin AT the source is arithmetically wrong for a source of finite radius; T8's own instrument refits z0 and is unaffected.

C_PZ.what: planted-zero control per reader (rule 3, L-340), sized RELATIVE TO EACH READER'S OWN SCALE rather than to an absolute constant -- the lesson T8_STEADINESS_MEASUREMENT_2026-08-26.md section 7.2 paid for. POINT plant (2 cells) for the axis readers; ALL-CELL plant over the plume run for the integrating top-hat-radius reader; ALTERNATING +-plant over every window sample for the fluctuation reader S1, with a CONSTANT-offset arm that a working fluctuation reader must be near-blind to. Both arms, a measured detection ladder, and a refusal on a blind or noisy reader.

C_REF.what: route B on mtt_t15.py before any comparison: the closed form satisfies the three MTT ODEs (h^2-falling residuals), the flux identities hold to 1e-14, the registered source sits ON the similarity solution, an independent RK4 integration reproduces it to 1e-9 and returns the exponents to 1e-9, and a 1 percent mutation of c_b or of an exponent is REFUSED.

completion.note: capped is an INFRASTRUCTURE field and never a completion conjunct (L-342). UMean/TMean/UPrime2Mean/TPrime2Mean are PHYSICS-CRITICAL: every graded V-row is built from the time-averaged field and an absent average is not a zero.

predictions.P1: S1 PASS: sigma(w)/mean(w) <= 0.020 over [120, 240] s -- the URANS plume SETTLES. FALSIFIER: S1 > 0.020 together with S2 >= 0.5, a persistent fluctuation, which supports the genuinely-unsteady hypothesis instead.
predictions.P1_limit: REGISTERED BEFORE COMPUTE, NOT DISCOVERED AFTER: a 5 degree axisymmetric wedge admits NO azimuthal mode, so a PASS on S1 excludes AXISYMMETRIC unsteadiness only. It cannot and does not exclude genuinely unsteady three-dimensional physics.
predictions.P4: V3 GATE FAIL -- db/dz OUTSIDE [0.132, 0.156] -- while V1 and V2 PASS: T8's registered P1 (the kEpsilon round-jet anomaly biases the entrainment coefficient and not the exponents) confirmed on the unsteady formulation. FALSIFIER: V3 inside the band (P4 wrong, the anomaly did not bite here), or V1/V2 outside it (T8's P1 wrong).
predictions.P5: max Courant number over the window <= 0.8 (MEASURED in the scratch probe: 1.053 at start-up, decaying through 0.72 by t = 0.12 s).
predictions.P6: epsilon/k bounding occurs on at least 1 percent of steps -- T8 bounded epsilon on every level from Time = 24. REPORTED, never gated. FALSIFIER: zero bounding events, which would itself be the finding that the transient formulation removes the closure's unrealizability.
predictions.P7: C_STAT drift <= 0.05: the run reaches statistical stationarity inside the registered 120 s discard. FALSIFIER: drift > 0.05 -> NOT A RESULT on every row and the registered finding is that the discard was too short.
